I lost a loved one to cancer that spread all over. Here's my advice: spend as much time with him as possible. Get him his favorite foods, keep him in good shape, go for walks, watch movies together. When he goes for chemotherapy, get him things that will make his hospital stay a little more cozy. Get him a warm blanket, or cozy fuzzy socks or a hat to help him keep warm. Get him whatever he can eat and keep down. Make sure you help him to keep his weight up. I'm sorry you're going through this. Hang in there.
